Use coherent combinations rather than arbitrary field packing, and allow useful overlap between bundles. Do not simply return 22 singleton bundles. Keep meanings concise and describe structural distinctions and boundaries, never expected accuracy or beneficial operation directions. Do not change field definitions, invent derived fields, output thresholds, model weights, numerical gains, evidence IDs, or executable rules. Before returning JSON, check the union of all features equals exactly the 22 provided names, no field is omitted, no bundle is duplicated, and each bundle has at most three fields. Coverage is mandatory but not a claim of better performance. Use no information other than the supplied grammar, field definitions and unlabelled examples.
